From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform — Wed 11th Feb

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the quick scheduling call earlier. We have a 45-minute demo slot penciled for Wed, Feb 11 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the Redwood Inference platform and a short Q&A.

To make the demo most valuable for your team, we plan to:
- Show a tailored walkthrough using your sample prompt sets and a few workload traces
- Demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs (batching, quantization) on a small replica of your workflow
- Confirm minimal access requirements for a hands-on trial (S3 samples + SSO/SCIM)

Attached are three short artifacts to review before the demo: redwood-demo-prompt-sets.pdf (example prompt sets we use in demos), workload-traces-sample.json (format we ingest), and access-checklist.xlsx (required accounts/permissions). Can you confirm who on your side will own providing sample traces and whether they require anything from us to set up SSO?

If you anticipate needing extra time to gather data, happy to move the demo — I want to make sure Camila has time to prepare a tailored run rather than a generic walkthrough. Proposed alternatives if Wednesday conflicts: Feb 17-19 mornings PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-prompt-sets.pdf, workload-traces-sample.json, access-checklist.xlsx

Marissa —

Thanks for scheduling. The timing is tight for us — our CFO (key stakeholder) is traveling through Feb 11 and our data engineering lead is tied up with a release. More importantly, we need a little lead time to pull representative traces and get SSO set up so the demo can include live ingestion and a meaningful latency/cost discussion.

Can we move this to the week of Feb 16? Prefer Tue/Thu mornings PT (Feb 17 or 19). Also, can your team run a 30-minute pre-demo tech check with our data engineer to validate sample format and access? That will make the main demo far more productive.

Oliver
